text_en: This is what the Lord God showed me—a basket of summer fruit.
text_cn: 吾主上主叫我看见这事：看，有一篮熟果子。

text_en: He said, “Amos, what do you see? ” And I said, “A basket of summer fruit. ” Then the Lord said to me, “The end has come upon my people Israel; I will never again pass them by.
text_cn: 上主说：“亚毛斯，你看见了什么？”我答说：“一篮熟果子。”上主又向我说：“我百姓以色列的结局已成熟，我不再放过她。

text_en: The songs of the temple shall become wailings in that day, ” says the Lord God ; “the dead bodies shall be many, cast out in every place. Be silent! ”
text_cn: 在那一天，王宫中的歌女必要哀号──吾主上主的断语──尸体成堆，抛在各处；鸦雀无声。”

text_en: Hear this, you that trample on the needy, and bring to ruin the poor of the land,
text_cn: 压榨穷人，使世上弱小绝迹的人哪！你们应听。

text_en: saying, “When will the new moon be over so that we may sell grain; and the sabbath, so that we may offer wheat for sale? We will make the ephah small and the shekel great, and practice deceit with false balances,
text_cn: 你们说：“月朔几时才过去，好让我们卖五谷？安息日几时才过去，好让我们打开粮仓，缩小‘厄法’，加重‘协刻耳’，用假秤欺人？

text_en: buying the poor for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, and selling the sweepings of the wheat. ”
text_cn: 用银钱购买穷人，以一双鞋换取贫人，连麦糠也卖掉？”

text_en: The Lord has sworn by the pride of Jacob: Surely I will never forget any of their deeds.
text_cn: 上主指着雅各伯的夸耀起誓说： 我永不会忘了他们的所作所为。

text_en: Shall not the land tremble on this account, and everyone mourn who lives in it, and all of it rise like the Nile, and be tossed about and sink again, like the Nile of Egypt?
text_cn: 难道不是因此大地才震动，地上的居民才悲号，全地泛滥有如尼罗，退落有如埃及大河？

text_en: On that day, says the Lord God , I will make the sun go down at noon, and darken the earth in broad daylight.
text_cn: 在那一天──吾主上主的断语──我必使太阳在中午落下，使大地白昼变为黑暗；

text_en: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; I will bring sackcloth on all loins, and baldness on every head; I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and the end of it like a bitter day.
text_cn: 使你们的喜庆变为丧事，使你们的一切乐曲变为哀歌，使你们都腰系苦衣，头都剃光；使你们哀悼，如哀悼独生子，使那一天始终是愁苦的日子。

text_en: The time is surely coming, says the Lord God , when I will send a famine on the land; not a famine of bread, or a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord .
text_cn: 看，那些日子一来临──吾主上主的断语──我必使饥饿临于此地，不是对食物的饥饿，也不是对水的饥渴，而是对听上主的话的饥渴。

text_en: They shall wander from sea to sea, and from north to east; they shall run to and fro, seeking the word of the Lord , but they shall not find it.
text_cn: 他们必由这海走到那海，由北至东，去寻求上主的话，但却寻不到。

text_en: In that day the beautiful young women and the young men shall faint for thirst.
text_cn: 在那一天，美丽的处女和健壮的青年，必因饥渴而晕眩。

text_en: Those who swear by Ashimah of Samaria, and say, “As your god lives, O Dan, ” and, “As the way of Beer-sheba lives”— they shall fall, and never rise again.
text_cn: 那些指着撒玛黎雅的罪过起誓，那些说：“丹，你的神永在”，或说：“贝尔舍巴，你的护守神永在”的人，必要跌倒，再不能起来。”
